verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for an identity-verification SaaS, since it could ship a copilot or conversational console, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a drag-and-drop no-code Workflow Builder, API/SDK integration, and an llms.txt documentation file. llms.txt makes the docs readable by LLMs but does not let users operate the product through natural-language commands. No natural-language command interface, assistant or copilot is evidenced.
